query:
SELECT 
  po.id,
  po.docNumber,
  po.totalAmount,
  po.freightCost,
  po.chargesCost,
  po.status,
  p.name as supplier
FROM purchaseOrders po
LEFT JOIN partners p ON po.supplierId = p.id
WHERE po.id = 2490001
